Theme 059 · Signature directions

Mobile Notifications

The phone is the stage: a lock screen drowning in banners, an app icon that pops open on the drop, and a Dynamic-Island-style Live Activity that expands into the proof. In a square frame the phone is cropped oversized or tilted 3/4, and big serif headlines fill the negative space.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Oversized device — concentric corners (outer 112 − bezel 14 = inner 98), cropped larger than the frame
  • Island · compact — black pill with a leading icon and trailing count; teal = watching, coral = alert
  • Live Activity — the expanded island: segment bar, one anomaly line, mono context, two action buttons
  • Banner stack — frosted white r32 banners; newest on top, older ones scale .95 → .90 and fade
  • Icon launch — the Acme mark inside a white screen with concentric echoes, zooming like an app opening
  • Island → CTA morph — the black pill detaches, turns coral and stretches into “Start free”

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Banner drop — y −80 → 0 with slight overshoot, back.out(1.3) 0.35 s, one per beat (0.5 s at 120 BPM)
  • Island stretch — width/height spring (stiffness 300, damping 22) ≈ 0.45 s, overshoot 1.04, triggered on a bar downbeat
  • Rolling digits — counters roll vertically per digit, 0.3 s power2.out — digits never hard-cut

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

Everyone knows what a notification feels like, so the pain and the fix need no explanation, and the Live Activity shows “background agent that surfaces only what matters” natively. Risk: a small phone in a square frame is unreadable — crop tight and let one element fill the frame at a time.

Adapt to your product: Show your product’s real push or widget surface; the Live Activity pattern suits anything with a status that changes over minutes (deploys, deliveries, jobs, incidents).

References: https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2023/10194/ (Design dynamic Live Activities (WWDC23)) · https://developer.apple.com/news/?id=bkm73839 (Explore Live Activities and the Dynamic Island)
